summary: This is a presentation slide layout using Pandoc markdown syntax. It creates a two-column layout on the first slide with images on the left (70% width) and two images stacked on the right (30% width), then adds speaker notes explaining what's shown. A second slide follows with a single image.

explanations.3: This begins a columns block, which tells the renderer to split the slide into multiple side-by-side sections.
explanations.4: This creates the first column and sets it to take up 70% of the slide width.
explanations.8: This creates the second column and sets it to take up the remaining 30% of the slide width.
explanations.15: This starts a notes section containing speaker notes that won't display on the slide itself but will appear in presenter view or speaker notes output.
